changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwpreauthorizationdiagnosis AS SELECT pad.id, pad.pre_authorization_id, pad.sequence, pad.diagnosis_code, pad.diagnosis_description, pad.diagnosis_type, pad.on_admission, pad.created_date, pad.created_by, pad.last_modified_by, pad.last_modified_date FROM public.pre_authorization_diagnosis pad;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwpreauthorizationdiagnosis TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwpreauthorizationdiagnosis FROM report_user;
